title: This Ant Jumps by Biting Sand
description:
A trap-jaw ant snaps its jaws in midair. No lift. The same snap against the sand launches it.

One jump clears the antlion pit. Another hits the wall and falls back in. In the lab, researchers glued the tips of some ants' jaws shut. Could they still escape without the snap?

Monarch Cam #1A · Cinematic CGI reconstruction based on published research, not wildlife or lab footage. Sound and motion are illustrative.

Research: Larabee & Suarez (2015), trap-jaw ant escapes and the jaw-restraint experiment: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0124871
Sutton et al. (2022), the dual-spring jaw mechanism: https://doi.org/10.1242/jeb.244077
Music: Original arrangement using FluidR3_GM samples by Frank Wen and contributors, packaged by Benjamin Gleitzman. Samples excerpted and edited for the Short.
